meta.title: The Original Raw Denim Jeans: Levi 501 STF (Shrink to Fit)
meta.description:
Want to buy 501's? https://fave.co/3DFMF9A

Are Levi's the ULTIMATE RAW DENIM JEANS? No, definitely not. There are some unbelievable jeans out there. However for the price (I paid $30) do they have much competition? No way. Levi 501 STF's are the original CLASSIC jean. Even though their quality is lacking sometimes.
